name: YouWare
description_en:
YouWare currently presents an AI work partner for research reports, slide decks, spreadsheets and websites. Its web-app documentation also describes generating, visually editing and publishing applications, so the coding workflow is one part of a broader product.

Evaluate the output you actually need: a generated website, a spreadsheet and a sourced report have different acceptance requirements. The site’s specialist-agent and checking descriptions do not establish that every delivered calculation, citation or application is correct.
description_zh:
YouWare 当前将自己呈现为研究报告、幻灯片、电子表格及网站的AI工作伙伴。其网页应用文档还说明生成、可视编辑及发布应用，因此编程流程只是更大产品的一部分。

应评估实际需要的输出：生成网站、表格及带来源报告的验收条件不同。官网所述专家Agent和检查流程，不能证明每次交付的计算、引用或应用正确。

sections.title_en: Create, refine and publish a project
sections.en:
The quick-start guide requires an account and modern browser. It offers building from a prompt or remixing a community project, followed by chat changes, visual edits and a code view. All users can inspect generated code, while direct editing is described as subscriber functionality. Publishing produces a shareable project URL.

A hypothetical pilot is a small event page with a form. Inspect fields, error states and mobile layout before publishing; a visible form does not prove submissions are stored or access-controlled. Test the intended backend separately. The guide’s short generation-time estimate is not a measured performance result in this research.
sections.zh:
快速入门要求账户及现代浏览器，可从提示构建或改编社区项目，再通过聊天、可视编辑和代码视图调整。所有用户可查看生成代码，直接编辑则描述为订阅者功能，发布后产生可分享项目URL。

假设试点可做带表单的小型活动页，发布前检查字段、错误状态及移动布局；显示表单不能证明提交已被保存或有访问控制。目标后端需另测。指南所述短生成时间不是本文测得性能结果。

sections.title_en: Remix export has an explicit restriction
sections.title_zh: 改编项目导出有明确限制
sections.en:
The quick-start guide says projects created through Remix cannot be downloaded as source code. That condition matters even when code can be inspected inside the app. Confirm whether a project starts from scratch or remix before choosing it for a handoff that requires an external repository.

The current homepage describes importing PDFs, presentations, documents, spreadsheets and CSVs for work tasks, with editable/exported reports and slides. Those workflows were not executed here. Open each exported format in its destination software, recalculate spreadsheet results and verify report sources before sharing. A slide example does not establish the web-builder’s deployment rights or backend durability.
sections.zh:
快速指南明确说明通过Remix创建的项目不能下载源码。即使应用内能查看代码，这一条件仍影响交付；需要外部仓库时应先确认项目来自新建还是改编。

当前首页说明导入PDF、演示、文档、表格和CSV开展任务，并交付可编辑／导出的报告及幻灯片。本文未执行这些流程。分享前应在目标软件打开各格式导出，重算表格并核对报告来源。幻灯片示例不能确定网页构建器的部署权益或后端持久性。

sections.title_en: Do not infer a tariff from an empty plan selector
sections.title_zh: 不能从空套餐选择器推断价格
sections.en:
The public subscription URL returned a Plans and Pricing shell with Subscription, Credits and Teams labels, but no readable amounts or allowance definitions. Current numeric pricing and renewal therefore remain unknown. The quick-start guide supports the existence of subscriber-only code editing, not the purchase price or complete plan matrix.

The documentation’s app-builder focus differs from the broader current homepage. Confirm which plan covers the intended deliverable, whether credits refresh or expire and what exports are permitted. No purchase, code export, agent task, data-retention audit or platform source-license review was performed.
sections.zh:
公开订阅URL返回Plans and Pricing外壳，有Subscription、Credits、Teams标签，但无可读金额或额度定义，因此当前数字费用和续费未知。快速指南能证明直接代码编辑被标为订阅者功能，不能证明购买价或完整套餐矩阵。

文档聚焦应用构建器，与当前首页更广范围不同。应确认所需产物对应哪套餐、额度如何补充／过期及允许哪些导出。本文未购买、导出代码、执行Agent任务、审计数据保留或查平台源码许可。
